design_assessment: Preserves historical migrations and exact two-edge migration identity; removes rejected global role authority changes and exposed privileged helper. Explicit operator-only database finalization addresses actual conflict.

Fixed six-relation allowlist, expected source/target ownership, shape and empty staging checks, deterministic bounded locks and atomic transfer are appropriate. Catalog-derived readiness and explicit real serving DB integration prevent probe-only success.

Future privileged Account DDL is explicit separate dependency/HOLD; finalizer v1 cannot silently reclaim ownership or become generic DDL. Real admin binding and exact transport lifecycle must precede deployment exposure.

Test-fixture amendment invokes the same production SQL after real app migration; raw migration probes explicitly do not fabricate SQLx ledger. This remains proposed design, not completed application integration.

Latest revision explicitly gates DB-backed API/worker AppState construction and readyz, exempts migration while disallowing configured-DB failure bypass through noDB mode. Production wrapper requires actual SQLx provenance and job success without missing-ledger flag.

LC01–LC08 specify meaningful negative/positive controls, exact state and request/effect completeness including NULL/empty responses and connection-failure false refusal. Tests remain explicitly unimplemented; this verdict approves design submission only.
